up: Return the exact activity values and structures for all compounds tested in the assay with identifier CHEMBL1614364. Include the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for each compound, along with the precise activity value, units, and the activity type (e.g., IC50, Ki).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_type
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614364'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
